name: Volume Partitioning Pipeline
definition: Splits a 3D volume into foreground regions, optionally partitions them spatially or by intensity, crops to bounding boxes, downsamples, and exports as raw files with metadata.
summary: The Volume Partitioning Pipeline reduces memory footprint by partitioning 3D volumes into cropped, compact raw files, distinguishing itself through explicit partitioning and bounding-box extraction rather than general segmentation.
